  scribal_relationship:

    scribe_certainty: High
    production_info: Colophon
    function_of_copying: Main Text
    scribe_role: Main copyist
    comments: 'Kunigund Niklasin, Nuremberg, Colophon, High, Nuremberg, Stadtbibliothek,
      Cent. IV 33, Parchment is used for f.s 1, 156-157, 230, 265-266, 277-278, and
      consistently for the outer double leaf of each quire. cursive book script by
      three different hands: 1. f.s 7r-145v, 164r-225v, 227r-257v by Kunigund Niklasin.
      2. f.s 2r-4v, 148r-158r, 171r-v, 226r-v, 230r-v, 258r-281v, and fragments at
      5r and 289r by Klara Keiperin. 3. Later additions at the end of the 15th or
      early 16th century (282r after the text). Copied by Kunigund Niklasin and Klara
      Keiperin from a book borrowed from the convent by a virgin named Anna Winterin,
      which was later passed to Margareta Scheurerin in Pforzheim. Of the original
      three-volume work (previously signed E I–III), only this second volume has survived.'
  production_unit:
    id: '25376'
